name: In Nomine
source:
As Grace’s mysterious illness worsens, she is urged to move in with her best friend, who becomes her caretaker. As the boundaries between them begin to blur, they must decide whether to change their ways or remain trapped in the life they have created.

[From [url=https://mwuoer.itch.io/in-nomine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
随着格蕾丝神秘的病情恶化，她被敦促搬去和她最好的朋友住在一起，后者成为了她的看护人。随着他们之间的界限开始模糊，他们必须决定是改变自己的生活方式还是继续受困于自己创造的生活中。

[来自[url=https://mwuoer.itch.io/in-nomine]Itch.io[/url]]
